method: Manually marked anatomical coordinates; x edges exclusive. Screen-axis distances. Genuine pitch, front/rear views, tucked bodies and rotated axes are separate comparisons. No colour-index measurements. Coordinate placement uncertainty approximately 1px. Native references are pose comparisons, not a claim Sonic anatomy equals pangolin anatomy.
limits: Native Sonic landmark rectangles have not been individually certified.
Rotated/occluded landmarks remain null; no inferred widths.
Some rear/tumble hood drawings are broader, requiring a separate native-axis audit before certification.
